sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m') AS 月份, ROUND(SUM(m.milk_yield), 2) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-04-01' AND m.record_date < '2026-09-29' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

q: 近7天每天产奶量
note: 真值区间内无任何记录,空/0 才是对的
sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(m.record_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS 日期, ROUND(SUM(m.milk_yield), 2) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-09-22' AND m.record_date < '2026-09-29' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

q: 今年各季度的产奶量
sql: SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(m.record_date), '-Q', QUARTER(m.record_date)) AS 季度, ROUND(SUM(m.milk_yield), 2) AS 产奶量 FROM dwh_fact_milk m LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_cattle c ON m.cattle_id = c.id LEFT JOIN dwh_dim_farm f ON m.farm_id = f.id WHERE m.record_date >= '2026-01-01' AND m.record_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1000
